title: Live GitHub pin race · 2 workers
mission: Act as a real GitHub-backed /wc contention fixture. Every fresh worker that selects this job must follow PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1 exactly and race on the same deterministic G000001 path. Winner may create only the matching claim receipt and inspect durable collisions; loser creates no execution claim, persists prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1, then immediately re-enters allocation. No product-surface mutation and no production /w promotion.
definition_of_done: Exactly one G000001 pin winner exists for this job.
Exactly one durable prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipt exists for generation 1 from a distinct /wc worker_id.
The loser created no authoritative execution claim.
Result is recorded as canary evidence only and does not promote production /w.
